title: Respectful Inquiry: Intention to Integrate Shizuku/LSPosed API in GPL-3.0 Open Source Project
body:
Dear maintainers,

First of all, thank you very much for your excellent work on this project. I am the developer of [Pixel Toolbox](https://github.com/abc1812645224-alt/pixel-toolbox), a non-root optimization tool for Pixel devices.

I am writing to respectfully inform you that I have integrated your API into my project. To comply with the open-source spirit and ensure I respect your licenses (including GPL-3.0 and Apache 2.0), I have fully open-sourced my project under the GPL-3.0 license. 

I just wanted to drop a message to express my gratitude and ensure that I am following the community guidelines properly. If there is anything else I should be aware of regarding the integration, please let me know.

Thank you for your time and for providing such an amazing tool to the community!

Best regards,
Developer of Pixel Toolbox
